errors.text_span: подредени във възходящ ред от горе надолу
errors.evidence: The categories on the y-axis are not sorted in any meaningful ascending or descending order; they are simply listed.

errors.text_span: Всеки сравнителен въпрос е представен с група от пет хоризонтални стълба
errors.evidence: There are six categories in the legend, not five. Each group of bars corresponds to these six categories, even if one value is 0.
The list of legend categories is incomplete; it omits the category 'Много по-труден' (Much harder), which corresponds to the light blue bars.

errors.text_span: с една или две цифри след десетичната запетая
errors.evidence: All data labels on the chart have exactly one digit after the decimal point, not one or two.
In the first group of bars (age), the lowest value is 3.6% (for the blue bar 'Много по-лесен'), not 5.1%.
In the second group (gender), the lowest value is 0%, which corresponds to 'Много по-труден' (light blue), not the purple bar ('Малко по-труден'), which has a value of 1.3%.
In the third group (citizenship), the lowest value is 1.2%, which corresponds to the light blue bar ('Много по-труден'), not the purple bar ('Малко по-труден'), which has a value of 7.5%.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете във всяка група са подредени във възходящ ред отгоре надолу според цветовете в легендата
errors.evidence: The phrase 'възходящ ред' (ascending order) is incorrect. The bars are ordered sequentially as they appear in the legend, which is not a numerical sorting.
